app.name: Story Writer
app.loadFailed: This story could not be opened.

note.title: Author's note
note.empty: Leave instructions for the next chapter
note.explanation: These are your instructions for writing the next chapter. They are sent with every chapter until you change them.
note.clearedAfter: This note is cleared after the next chapter.
note.label: Instructions for the next chapter
note.placeholder: e.g. Vimes finally meets the dragon. Keep it funny and end on a cliffhanger.
note.depthHint: 0 = right before your request for the next chapter, 1 = before the latest chapter, and so on.

actions.label: Story actions
actions.rewriteMessage: The text of chapter {{number}} will be replaced by a new version. This cannot be undone.
actions.noConnection: Choose a connection in the story settings to start writing.
actions.finishChapter: Finish chapter {{number}} and write the next one

stories.exportTextLabel: Download the story as plain text
stories.busy: Stories can be switched once the model has finished.
stories.deleteMessage: The story and all its chapters will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
stories.savedHint: Every story saves itself as you write. Open any of them from this list at any time.
stories.saveFailed: Some changes could not be saved yet. Story Writer keeps trying.

story.title: Title
story.overviewPlaceholder: What is the story about? The premise, the setting, the main conflict and where it should go.
story.overviewHint: The model reads this before every chapter.
story.author: Author
story.authorHint: The model writes in this author's style.
story.stylePlaceholder: e.g. third person limited, present tense
story.notesPlaceholder: Names, places, rules and facts the model must keep straight.
story.notesHint: Your story bible. Sent with every chapter.

cast.charactersHint: Their cards are sent with every chapter.
cast.personasHint: Your personas are characters in this story too.
cast.lorebooksHint: Entries are picked by keywords from the story, like in chat.

writing.connectionHint: The model that writes this story. Its parameters are set in the connection editor.
writing.noConnections: No connections yet. Add one to start writing.
writing.targetHint: Leave empty for an open-ended story. The model is told how far along the story is.
writing.chapterTitlesHint: The model opens each chapter with a title.
writing.continueMessageHint: Sent as your message each time you ask for the next chapter.
writing.promptHint: The model's instructions, sent first in every request.
writing.bannedHint: Comma-separated. The model is told never to use them, and you are warned when one slips through.
writing.streamingHint: Show the chapter while it is being written.

tools.summaryPlaceholder: What happens in this chapter, in a few sentences.
tools.deleteChapterMessage: The chapter and its summary will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
tools.summarizeOlderHint_one: {{count}} chapter outside the last {{keep}} has no summary yet.
tools.summarizeOlderHint_other: {{count}} chapters outside the last {{keep}} have no summary yet.
tools.summarizeOlderNone: Every chapter outside the last {{keep}} has a summary.
tools.keepFull: Keep the last chapters in full
tools.keepFullHint: Older chapters that have a summary are sent as their summary.
tools.autoSummarizeHint: Summarize a chapter once it falls outside the last chapters kept in full.
tools.timelineHint: Key events, in order. The model moves the story toward the next event that has not happened yet.
tools.clearNoteHint: Empty the sticky note once the model has written the chapter.

appearance.pageAnimationHint: Pages turn like paper in the book theme.

errors.loadPreferences: Could not load your Story Writer preferences.
errors.savePreferences: Could not save your reading preferences.
errors.duplicateUnsaved: Could not duplicate the story: some of its changes are not saved yet. Try again in a moment.
errors.saveSettings: Could not save the story settings.
errors.openConnection: The connection editor could not be opened from here. Open Connections from the main menu.

reader.ghostPlaceholder: Click here and start writing — or press Write and let the story begin.
reader.ghostWaiting: The next chapter will begin here.
reader.emptyChapterPlaceholder: This chapter is empty. Click here to write it, or press Write to continue it.

generation.bannedPhrases: The new text uses banned words or phrases: {{phrases}}
generation.cutOff: Chapter {{number}} stopped early. Press Write to continue it.

errors.empty: The model returned no text. Try again, or check the connection.
errors.failed: The model could not write this time.
errors.noConnection: Choose a connection in the sidebar before writing.
errors.summaryEmpty: The model returned an empty summary for chapter {{number}}.
errors.timelineUnreadable: The model's timeline could not be read, so your timeline was not changed.

summaries.nothingToSummarize: Every older chapter already has a summary.

generation.timelineChanged: You changed the timeline while it was being planned, so your version was kept.
